classifier_computation_note: Non-exact tiers compute only the class they report. Public-coordinate factorization is used inside the diagnostic to classify d4 and coarse higher buckets; exact tau values are not emitted for non-exact tiers.
header: This is a diagnostic calibration report. It is not a reduction evidence surface.

tiers.tier_0: parity and gap position only; no divisor-family detection
tiers.tier_1: prime_square vs non-prime_square; withholds d4 vs higher_divisor
tiers.tier_2: prime_square, d4, higher_divisor; no exact tau(n) when tau(n) > 4
tiers.tier_3: prime_square, d4, and coarse higher buckets; no exact tau(n) inside buckets
